title: Applying in volume without applying blindly

videos.script: A first job search is a numbers game, and people hear that and do the wrong thing with it. {{numbers}} They send the same CV to two hundred adverts in a weekend, get nothing back, and conclude the market is closed. {{blind}} The numbers are real: most applications get no answer, so you do need many. But each one still has to be aimed, or none of them lands. {{aim}} This lesson keeps a tracker, reads what it says, and shows how to aim an application in ten minutes rather than an hour.
